1.consolidated_definition: Sustentante. De sustentar, que sustenta. “El hombre es un ser que necesita en que apoyarse... Ese otro ser sustante es Dios.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: Sustentante. From sustain, that sustains. "The man is a being who needs something to rely on... That other sustaining being is God."
